comment: Consent, authorisation, and privacy are grouped in a single row even though they have different legal and technical purposes. Consent does not always provide the legal basis for healthcare-data processing, and authorisation is not equivalent to consent.

public.text: Consent, authorisation, and privacy are grouped in a single row even though they have different legal and technical purposes. Consent does not always provide the legal basis for healthcare-data processing, and authorisation is not equivalent to consent.
public.suggestedRevision: Split the row into separate capabilities for consent or preference management, legal-basis and purpose management, authorisation and access control, and privacy-policy enforcement.
